## What's new

Threadnote 5.0.0-beta.8 keeps useful code-graph context available while a refresh is underway, so agents can continue tracing source relationships instead of waiting for a rebuild to finish.

Threadnote 5 helps agents start from current, cited code context without repeatedly rebuilding an entire repository for every task. This beta makes that workflow more reliable when a graph needs an update.

### Keep exploring while code evidence refreshes

When Threadnote prepares newer code evidence, it continues to serve the last ready graph for compatible questions. Agents can still follow symbols, relationships, and impact through existing source context while the update runs, then pick up the refreshed graph when it is ready.

Slow graph updates also stay contained to the work that started them. That makes background refreshes more dependable and helps avoid unnecessary resource use while you keep working.
